review.brief: Boundary (analytics + KB guide only); D1 amendment (UnfinishedReader, not Reader); SQL shape (unnest+NOT EXISTS, DISTINCT, ascending, pgtype.Date, existing unique index, no migration); empty-input no-query contract; test values authored up front in design.md; comments carry no design.md/decision/ticket IDs; docs (AGENTS.md, KB guide) updated; anti-gaming on tasks.md T5.

findings.note: internal/analytics/db_unfinished_integration_test.go:91,100,109,118 -- t.Run names "TR-2 ..."/"TR-3 ..."/"TR-4 ..."/"TR-5 ..." bake in design.md's own test-reference labels. The leader's cleanup event removed design.md/TR-N pointers from comments but missed these because they are t.Run() string literals, not // comments. Once design.md is read-only, "TR-2" means nothing to someone reading go test -v output. Not blocking -- rename to a descriptive subtest name (e.g. "some done some not", already present as suffix text) with no code-behavior change.

decisions.decision: Override design D1: UnfinishedForDate goes on a new narrow interface (UnfinishedReader), not on Reader. T5 (4 cross-module fake stubs) becomes unnecessary.
decisions.why: Widening Reader breaks 3 gateway fakes for a method only the poller calls; narrow ports (Recalculator, MonthlySyncer) are the module's pattern.
